description: This file defines a Console class for logging and displaying messages in a web page, including styling and ANSI color support. It also exports functions and variables related to console creation and configuration.

classes.name: Console
classes.description: A class for creating and managing a styled console output area in a web page, with methods for logging, warning, error, and clearing messages, as well as injecting ANSI color styles.

methods.name: _createElement
methods.description: Creates a DOM element with specified tag and id, appending it to a host element (default is document.body).

methods.name: Console.log
methods.description: Adds a log message to the console display.

methods.name: Console.warn
methods.description: Adds a warning message with an icon and styled background.

methods.name: Console.error
methods.description: Adds an error message with styled background.

methods.name: Console.clear
methods.description: Clears all messages from the console display.

methods.name: Console.injectAnsiColorCSS
methods.description: Injects CSS styles for ANSI color codes into the document head.

methods.name: Console.format_colors
methods.description: Formats a string with ANSI escape codes into HTML spans with corresponding styles.
